thread:
vivian cruz: quick design review  found a few accessibility + clarity nits on the Private setup wizard networking step during today's lab: 1) status colors on the probe pills rely on hue alone (red/green)  need icon + text and better contrast; 2) the CIDR helper copy feels too prescriptive for mixed infra customers; 3) the "Repair" CTA in the probe details reads like a destructive action. can we iterate?
maia nguyen: agree on color issue. propose using status icons (check / warning / x) + label text: "Passed", "Partial", "Failed". microcopy for partial: "Partial  some checks passed". also update CSS to meet 4.5:1 on the pill background.
jamal taylor: accessibility: add aria-labels that include status text (e.g., "DNS probe: Passed"). for colors, ensure we don't rely on color only: aria-hidden icons + visible text. For the Repair button change, suggest renaming to "Apply suggested fix" with a confirmation step for potentially disruptive repairs.
andrew liu: layout note  make the status pill left of the probe label so it reads: [icon] DNS resolution  Passed  120ms. reduces scan time. For small screens stack the timing to the right. Also reduce visual weight of the Repair button (outline) and move secondary actions into a kebab menu.
vivian cruz: small copy tweak for CIDR helper: current: "Enter network in CIDR notation (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16)." propose: "Enter the control-plane CIDR in CIDR notation. Examples: IPv4 10.0.0.0/16, IPv6 fd00::/8. If unsure, contact your network owner." keeps actionable guidance without presuming dual-stack choice.
maia nguyen: alternative shorter helper that fits mobile: "Control-plane CIDR (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16 or fd00::/8). Ask your network owner if unsure." and add a tooltip for more nuance.
jamal taylor: keyboard flow: ensure probe list is a single tabbable list; Expand/Collapse chevrons should be buttons with aria-expanded. When details open focus goes to the close button; Esc closes and restores focus to the chevron. Also add role="region" + aria-labelledby on the details area so SR users can jump.
design-bot: uploaded mock: https://files.redwood.ai/ux/probe-status-pills-202607.png :mag: shows icons + text + updated contrast.
andrew liu: e2e test plan: keyboard tab sequence covering Run -> first pill -> expand -> Esc -> focus restored. Also test visual contrast with dark theme.
vivian cruz: action items: maia will update microcopy + tooltip, jamal will add aria labels/restore-focus/region roles and rename Repair to "Apply suggested fix" with a confirmation modal, and andrew will update layout and tests. target: include in next minor release. thanks :thumbsup:
